name: Oil
operation_language: Authoring intent only; not registered engine syntax.

rules.text: Douse creature/object: replace one Attack-action attack by throwing a flask within 20 feet, Dexterity save DC 8 + Dexterity modifier + PB or covered for 1 minute; Fire damage before drying adds 5 Fire damage. Douse level ground: Utilize, 5-foot square within 5 feet; when lit burns until end of turn 2 rounds later (12 seconds), 5 Fire on entry or turn end, at most once per turn. Fuel: each flask gives 6 cumulative hours in Lamp/Lantern; Utilize extinguishes, later rekindling spends remaining fuel.

definition.name: Oil (Flask)
definition.description: A flask of lamp oil. Can be splashed and ignited for 5 fire damage, or used to refuel a lantern.

unsupported_behavior.requirement: Keep three distinct uses: attack replacement dousing, placed burning ground with once-per-turn damage, and six cumulative hours of fuel. Map durations and same-turn ordering without guessing unknown target facts.
